description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

written.description: Checks an agent skill before you install it, following the files it pulls in and asking a model whether any of it is trying to misdirect the agent. Each verdict carries the provenance behind it.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(supply_chain): scan tool-specific pyproject.toml dependency tables (Poetry/PDM/Hatch/uv) (#190)

* feat(supply_chain): scan Poetry/PDM/Hatch/uv pyproject dependency tables

Route [tool.poetry.*], [tool.pdm.dev-dependencies],
[tool.hatch.envs.*.dependencies] and [tool.uv.dev-dependencies] through the
bounded extend_specs parser so `limit` is honoured and PEP 508 entries go
through packaging.Requirement.

Poetry bare versions ("2.31.0") are exact pins and become name==2.31.0 so
SC4 can look them up; ranges (^, ~, *, >=,<) stay unpinned. Poetry's
`python` key is skipped.

Closes #171

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Lalit Shrotriya <shrotriya.lalit@outlook.com>

* fix(supply_chain): only pin Poetry versions that are a single concrete release

A digit-leading Poetry constraint such as "1.2.3 || 1.2.4" was rewritten to
the invalid requirement "name==1.2.3 || 1.2.4", which packaging rejects, so
the dependency was dropped from SC4/SC5/SC6 and lockfile reconciliation.

Gate the == rewrite on a strict single-version pattern; any other Poetry
syntax (||, spaces, commas, wildcards) keeps the package name unpinned.
Add regressions for string and {version = ...} forms.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Lalit Shrotriya <shrotriya.lalit@outlook.com>
